additionalSpeciesObservations.locality: Balsahan Stream in the Iwahig Prison and Penal Farm, Puerto Princesa City, Palawan

evidenceSummary.en: The authors report finding three female individuals; two were collected and listed as comparative material. The paper identifies one collected female as voucher WPU-PPC-P 10 (43.7 mm standard length).
evidenceSummary.fil: Iniulat ng mga may-akda ang tatlong babaeng indibidwal; dalawa ang nakolekta at inilista bilang comparative material. Tinukoy ng caption ang isang nakolekta bilang voucher WPU-PPC-P 10 (43.7 mm standard length).

additionalSpeciesObservations.currentStatus: Valid as Stiphodon percnopterygionus Watson & Chen 1998
additionalSpeciesObservations.locality: Balsahan Stream in the Iwahig Prison and Penal Farm, Puerto Princesa City, Palawan

evidenceSummary.en: One wild male was identified during snorkel observation from body and fin markings. The authors say it was not collected; the paper reports no voucher for this observation.
evidenceSummary.fil: Nakilala sa snorkel observation ang isang lalaking isda batay sa marka ng katawan at palikpik. Ayon sa mga may-akda, hindi ito nakolekta at walang voucher na iniulat para sa obserbasyong ito.

additionalSpeciesObservations.locality: Iwahig River, Puerto Princesa City, Palawan

evidenceSummary.en: One preserved specimen is listed from this collection event: NSMT-P 45093 (51.2 mm standard length).
evidenceSummary.fil: Isang preserved specimen ang nakatala mula sa collection event na ito: NSMT-P 45093 (51.2 mm standard length).

additionalSpeciesObservations.locality: Iwahig River at Quezon, Palawan, on the South China Sea side of the island; a different river from the Iwahig River at Puerto Princesa City

evidenceSummary.en: The authors qualitatively described Stiphodon pulchellus as abundant during a two-day exploration. They gave no count and listed no voucher for this field observation.
evidenceSummary.fil: Inilarawan ng mga may-akda ang Stiphodon pulchellus bilang marami sa dalawang-araw na eksplorasyon. Walang ibinigay na bilang o voucher para sa field observation na ito.

localityOnlyNote.reasonExcluded: No waterbody is named for this specimen group in the source, so it is not assigned to a river, stream, or lake.

source.citation: Maeda, K. & Palla, H. P. (2015). A new species of the genus Stiphodon from Palawan, Philippines (Gobiidae: Sicydiinae). Zootaxa, 4018(3), 381–395. https://doi.org/10.11646/zootaxa.4018.3.3.
source.adaptationNote: Two scope-limited attributed projections: locality/date/voucher/count facts from Material examined, and paraphrased named-site field observations including one direct algae-feeding observation. No article prose, coordinates, map geometry, figures, or photographs are included.

limits: Historical specimen localities and dated field observations only; not evidence of current presence or standardized abundance.
Current Catalog of Fishes name statuses are cross-checked; they do not re-identify source specimens or field observations.
The separate feeding guide reports a specific algae-feeding observation from 2015; it is not a complete diet or bait recommendation. No fishing access, legality, or safety is asserted.
The remaining nine source specimens are locality-only at Tagbariri and are not mapped to a waterbody.
